notes: encode(decode(bytes).resize({ width, height }), { format: 'png' }), default options. Not passing: its resize samples between source pixels and does not average the area a thumbnail pixel covers.
details: The default interpolation is bilinear between the four nearest source pixels, so at a reduction of 4 it reads 4 of every 16 pixels, and it maps the corner pixels of the source onto the corner pixels of the result, which shifts the picture by up to half a thumbnail pixel. The mean error against the area average is 2.3 to 6.3 levels (limit 2; the entries that average the area are at 0.4 to 1.3). The nearest and bicubic settings of the package do no better, so there is no variant.
